uncited: The technique builds upon [Progressive Level Transitions](14190-progressive-level-transitions.md) and operates alongside [Piecewise Linear LOD Transition](22725-piecewise-linear-lod-transition.md).
**Mesh/Vertex Blending:** For rasterized meshes, vertices in the transition region possess positions from both LOD levels.
At the boundary between the high-resolution LOD and the transition, weights are $(1, 0)$.
**Point Cloud Filtering (Alternative):** For point clouds, assign each point an LOD value (0–3) based on spatial density.
LOD 0 covers 1×1×1 m volumes, LOD 1 covers 0.5×0.5×0.5 m, and LOD 2 covers 0.25×0.25×0.25 m.
